title.rendered: The Fruit of the Spirit: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: The fruit of the Spirit. Singular. One fruit, nine flavors. We are not manufactured into godliness. We are grown into it by the One who lives in us.

content.rendered:
The fruit of the Spirit. Singular. One fruit, nine flavors. And it is the fruit of the Spirit, not the fruit of your self-improvement. We are not manufactured into godliness. We are grown into it by the One who lives in us.

The Gospel For Today | Tuesday, May 26, 2026

Today’s Scripture

“But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faithfulness, gentleness, self-control; against such things there is no law.”
Galatians 5:22–23 (ESV)

Today’s Message

Notice two small grammatical details in this passage. First, Paul writes “the fruit of the Spirit,” not “the fruits of the Spirit.” It is singular. One cluster. Nine character qualities that grow together from the same root. You do not get to pick the ones you like. They come as a bundle, because they all flow from the same Person inside you.

Second, it is the fruit of the Spirit. Not the fruit of your effort. Not the fruit of your good intentions. Not the fruit of your self-improvement plan. The Spirit produces this fruit. He is the source. You are the soil where He grows it.

An apple tree does not produce apples by trying harder. It produces apples by being a healthy tree, rooted in good soil, drinking water, taking in sunlight. The fruit is the natural overflow of what is happening at the root. Strain has nothing to do with it. The same is true of you in Christ. The fruit of the Spirit is not manufactured by behavior modification. It is grown by abiding.

This is a profound relief if you receive it. You are not trying to become more loving by white-knuckling kindness. You are abiding in Christ, and love is what the Spirit naturally grows in you. You are not chasing patience by gritting your teeth. You are walking with the Spirit, and patience comes from Him. The transformation is from the inside out, not the outside in.

But fruit is grown, not given in completed form. The Spirit does not zap us into instant maturity. He grows fruit, and growing takes seasons. Sun and rain. Pruning shears. Drought and recovery. You are not behind if you are still growing. You are not failing if patience is still ripening in you. The vinedresser is faithful and the harvest is sure.

So today, instead of working harder at being a better version of yourself, abide. Stay close. Read His Word. Talk to Him. Walk with His Spirit. Trust Him to grow in you what only He can grow. You will find that love begins to flow where there used to be resentment. Joy begins to bubble where there used to be heaviness. Peace begins to settle where there used to be panic. Not because you tried harder. Because He grew it.

Prayer

Father, I am so tired of trying to manufacture what only You can grow. Today I lay down the self-improvement project and I abide in Christ. I trust Your Spirit in me to produce in His own time the fruit that pleases You. Make me content to grow. Make me faithful to abide. Make me confident in the Vine-dresser. In Jesus’ name. Amen.

Declaration

I do not manufacture the fruit of the Spirit. I abide. The Spirit grows what only He can grow. Love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faithfulness, gentleness, self-control—all of it grows from the Spirit who lives in me. I am rooted in Christ. The harvest is sure.

Go Deeper in the Word

  • John 15:1–8: Abide in Me and you will bear much fruit
  • Galatians 5:16–25: Walk by the Spirit and the flesh has no rule
  • Philippians 1:6: He who began a good work in you will complete it
